name: Persona adherence per generated student message
definition: Evaluates whether one generated student message matches the assigned persona contract.

score_scales.1: Severe persona failure. Any severe knowledge leak, severe under-competence, role collapse into co-teacher/expert, or direct persona-contract contradiction.
score_scales.2: Weak persona adherence. No Score 1 failure, but at least two moderate deviations across knowledge boundary, emotional tone, or behavioral rules.
score_scales.3: Acceptable persona adherence. Main knowledge boundary, emotional tone, and behavioral rules are respected; minor genericity or shallow persona signal may remain.
score_scales.4: Strong persona adherence. Score 3 baseline plus clear persona-specific question style, stable boundary handling, and only minor deviations.
score_scales.5: Excellent persona adherence. Highly distinctive persona signal with no boundary errors, no generic behavior, and natural emotional/behavioral consistency.
